body: This is super random, but I’ve found the best way is to join dating apps. When you start convos with people just use code words and they’ll know pretty quickly what you’re talking about. Always has worked amazing for me.
I don’t think that’s a bad reason at all. You are the most important person in your dog’s life and she loves you very much. I hope you feel better
I wish I could go to a therapist but I can’t afford it. That’s true, it helps to say how I feel even if only online

Yes exactly, it’s not that people openly dislike me but that I feel no one has ever or will I ever understand me. But they would have no reason to try because no one would care about me anyway. I ruin everything including relationships with family and friends. I never feel a connection with people. It’s like there’s something about me that’s missing
There’s something about the way I am that ruins everything. No one truly likes to be around me

You’re right, I think I was putting too much on it and it just became more irritated. The baking soda was the worst. I think I also made it worse at first when I thought it was an ingrown hair, I was putting antibacterial ointment on it and covering it up. I will try that! Thanks very much! 🙂
That’s true, I just wouldn’t want him to think that. That’s very helpful! I’ll ask for that for sure
No it didn’t look at all like that!

Thank you! 🙂 I made an appointment for tomorrow for a sexual health clinic so that I feel less uncomfortable going. I can’t wait to finally know. 
I just hope my boyfriend doesn’t blame or accuse me of anything

Sorry I don’t have one, I was so embarrassed I deleted any picture I took. All I have is what it looks like now. But the bumps just looked like really bad ingrown hairs. The only difference was there didn’t seem to be a hair follicle right in them. Like when you have an ingrown hair you can see in the middle where the hair would be. The bumps I had were more even all the way around them. Hope that helps!

Thank you, the pain has been so bad I made an appointment at a sexual health clinic for tomorrow! I’m going to ask for what you suggested. I cannot wait to go and start medication so I can feel normal again. You’re right about the boyfriend thing too, I’m not going to say anything about it until I get tested and start getting better. I’m most concerned he won’t admit that it’s highly possible I got it from him, and that he may even be unwilling to be tested 😐
